meta.title: YongGames | Indie Game Studio
meta.description: YongGames is an indie game studio making fun games that keep you saying "just one more round." Featured titles: Typing Clash and Don't Watch Ads.
hero.lead:
Games that make you say "just one more round!"
Like rolling dice, every play brings a new kind of fun.
games.heading: Our Games
tc.desc: Type words to summon units! Grow your army, unleash skills and out-type your opponent to win chaotic real-time battles. Play solo, or team up and face off with friends.
dwa.title: Don't Watch Ads
dwa.tagline: Get caught by an ad… and you'll have to watch a real one.
dwa.desc: Find the real X button, dodge fake SKIPs, refuse the "Get 3x rewards" trap! Over 200 mini-games that poke fun at the ads we see every day, served up at random. Climb all the way to stage 10,000 and compete on the global leaderboard.
coming.title: Next Project
coming.desc: It's still a secret. Stay tuned for our next game!
about.heading:
A small studio
serious about fun
about.desc: YongGames is an indie game studio that handles everything in-house, from design and development to art. We make games anyone can pick up easily and laugh at together with friends.
value1.title: Play comes first
value1.desc: We play our games every day to polish the feel and the pace.
value2.title: Easy and fun
value2.desc: We make games that are fun from the very first try.
value3.title: Together with players
value3.desc: We listen to your feedback and answer with updates.
news.heading: Studio News
news.item1: The official YongGames website is now open!
news.item2: Typing Clash is now available on Steam.
contact.heading: Let's make something fun together!
contact.desc: Partnerships, publishing, bug reports, or just saying hi — all welcome.
